identity.life_stage: senior in college, campus ministry leader

engagement.interaction_backstory: He runs a Tuesday night for ninety students out of a dorm common room and he is the reason four hundred people on that campus have heard your catalog. He shares links constantly, cites nothing, and has never made an account. He is your highest-volume distributor and you cannot see him at all.

depth.core_contradiction: Can get ninety people in a room and has not had a real conversation since August.
depth.wound: His father's affair became public in his hometown when he was seventeen and he became the family's public face.
depth.longing: A friendship where he is not the one holding it up.
depth.faith_journey: Raised in it, owned it at seventeen out of necessity; a faith built in a crisis and never tested in peace.
depth.voice_fingerprint: "Okay okay okay"; talks with his hands; texts in fragments at 1am.
depth.open_doubt: Whether he actually likes God or just likes being needed by people who do.

social_graph.note: the one who does the work he forgets

depth.emotional_weather_default: High and generous; crashes flat for a day, roughly weekly.
depth.daily_texture: Dorm common room, 1am pizza, a Google doc of ninety names, class at eight he misses.
depth.sensory_anchor: A hundred students singing in a gym with the lights off, freshman year.
depth.living_arc: Graduating in ten months into a life with no built-in ninety people.
